I'll start by reading `TASK.md` and `brief.md` in full, then follow the brief exactly—Section 0 takes priority—and write only under `work`.The brief is a stock-image orientation study: find the pose producer, add one labelled emulator-only injection, then measure AF target banks. I'll read the template and the cited research next.The stock AF path reads pose from setting `0xe91`, and E147’s accelerometer is not the E143 model. I’ll scan the image for the producer and the bank selector before any emulator change.The producer path is far enough along to try the register-read injection. I'll run a stock session that supplies the accelerometer sample at that read and records what the native orientation code stores.The direct screen opened on All, which has no movable point, and the second OK cleared the checks the first OK had set. The next session leaves both Orientation Linked rows on and dials to a target the arrows can move.The linked measurement is in. Landscape writes index 1, one portrait writes index 3, and the other writes index 5. I'll record that and the producer path.The stock orientation producer is the accelerometer, and the AF target banks follow the pose only while Orientation Linked is on.

The sensor is read on I2C channel 6, device `0x6b`. A 14-byte read of register `0x20` is unpacked by the native completion, copied by `ACC_MAIN`, and turned into a raw code by `PER_ROTATE` at `0xa32c5690`. The reported index is at `0xa32c568c`. The EXIF getter `0x60077de1` maps that index through the table at `0x60357e68` (11, 1, 6, 3, 8). `0xe91` stays 0 for every pose.

An emulator-only hook supplies those 14 bytes at the register read. The native probe, completion, copy, and `PER_ROTATE` still run. `work/scripts/pose.mjs` is the module other runners can import.

With both Orientation Linked rows checked (`0x1db1[0]` and `0x1dc1[0]` are 1), the direct target screen writes one change index:

| Pose | Sensor sample | Raw | EXIF | Index written in `0x99a1` and `0x5962` |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| landscape | (0, −1 g, 0) | 0 | 1 | 1, the normal change index |
| the other portrait | (−1 g, 0, 0) | 3 | 8 | 3, the CCW change index |
| the first portrait | (+1 g, 0, 0) | 1 | 6 | 5, the CW change index |

With both rows off, every pose writes index 1. The ten bytes at `0xa33ca384` stay 0. The arrow only moves a point after the main dial leaves All.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place. The producer writeup is `work/out/orientation-producer.md`, and the module interface is `work/out/pose-injection.md`.The orientation measurement is complete. The stock pose comes from the accelerometer, and with Orientation Linked on the direct target screen writes a different bank for each pose.

| Pose | Sensor sample | Bank index in `0x99a1` and `0x5962` |
|---|---|---|
| landscape | (0, −1 g, 0) | 1 |
| EXIF 8 | (−1 g, 0, 0) | 3 (CCW change) |
| EXIF 6 | (+1 g, 0, 0) | 5 (CW change) |

With Orientation Linked off, every pose writes index 1. `0xe91` stays 0. The reusable injection module is `work/scripts/pose.mjs`. `work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place.
